thesis: TSMC supports a profitable foundry-growth purchase through 36% revenue growth, 60.3% operating margin and internally funded investment. The bull adds actual Q2 FCF growth to NT$287.36bn, independently supporting owner-cash participation beyond investment gains. Estimated 22x forward earnings has substantive operating support, while margin normalization, inventory and Taiwan exposure keep conviction bounded rather than serving as automatic vetoes.
strongest_counterexample: Inventory days rose to 87, guided operating margin falls to 56-58%, and Taiwan concentration cannot be diversified away by NT$2,486.33bn liquid surplus; overseas fab returns may disappoint even with financially funded expansion.
invalidation_conditions: Reported operating margin below the prior comparable 49.6% with year-on-year revenue decline would invalidate the operating-improvement basis.
Comparable H1 CFO no longer exceeding capex, from NT$635.576bn positive cash after capex, would undermine the internally funded capacity thesis.
decisive_factors: Q2 FCF increased from NT$199.85bn; cash funding is observed and not reliant on Vanguard gains.
Prospective margin normalization need not return profitability to the prior-year level, but guidance is not achieved performance.
